steps: Close the game.
Choose Prepare UEVR. AVRcade adds the approved tools and game profile.
If the profile download fails, open View profile source.
Download the reviewed profile ZIP.
Choose Import VR profile ZIP. Do not unpack it into the game folder.
For a mod-manager VR launch, add -dx11 to that profile’s launch options.
Start your headset software.
Choose Recheck setup. A new game build still needs a compatible VR package.
Close the game.
Choose Download VR setup. AVRcade adds the approved UEVR tools and game profile.
If the profile download fails, open View profile source.
Download the reviewed profile ZIP.
Choose Import VR profile ZIP. Do not unpack it into the game folder.
Start your headset software.
Choose Recheck setup. Experimental tracked hands are optional.
Close the game.
Open the package source below.
Install the matched UUVR and AVRcade YAPYAP bridge package. Generic UUVR alone is not enough.
Start SteamVR, including when you connect through Virtual Desktop.
Choose Recheck setup.
For VR + mods, choose a profile containing both VR components.
For monitor mods, choose a profile without those VR plugins.
Choose the supported classic Windows game folder.
Close the game.
Choose Install VR bridge. AVRcade adds the bridge and OpenXR loader.
If the build is blocked, choose a compatible game version.
For Vanilla, choose a separate clean folder when requested in Mods.
Do not place another VR conversion over the managed bridge.
Close GTA IV and use Install VR package at the top. AVRcade checks the supported executable and downloads the configured package.
Use the startup and input settings below to select your headset controls. Connect through SteamVR, then choose Recheck setup after an external change.
If the build check blocks installation, use the supported game version named in the status. Installing a second VR conversion over the managed files will not resolve a mismatch.
Use the supported GTA V Legacy build shown in the status; this package does not support Enhanced. Close the game and use Install VR package at the top.
Complete normal Rockstar sign-in. Disable BattlEye in Rockstar Launcher for Story Mode, then select the runtime and controller mode in the settings below.
Keep the package for Story Mode. If setup fails, resolve the reported build or file conflict before retrying; do not add another VR conversion over it.
This is an experimental native VR route. Read the supported build and preparation status above before attempting a headset launch.
Use this page's Fallout preparation and Vortex controls for the native adapter. A community VR mod ZIP cannot be imported through the generic installer.
Close the game before changing its setup. Choose Recheck setup after preparation and confirm the result in the headset; installed files alone are not a headset validation.
Use Set up New Vegas VR and Vortex sync on this page. The setup dialog checks the game, native prerequisites and optional one-way Vortex synchronization.
Resolve each preparation error in the dialog, then close it and choose Recheck setup. Avoid copying an unrelated VR package into the game folder.
The native VR route is experimental. After preparation, connect the headset and use the native headset-test launch; package status does not imply that this hardware test has passed.

Choose Recheck setup after installation.
Test the image, tracking and controls in your headset.
